messages:
sam (Design): sketch: https://figma.redwood.example/file/legend-affordance

sam (Design): quick idea: add a compact legend affordance that groups sampling, p95, throughput, and 'high-impact events' into a single collapsible chip so the chart header doesn't get crowded. clicking expands detailed controls.

ila (Eng UI): i like reducing clutter. make sure collapsed state still clearly shows sampling percent and a small badge for enabled events. also keyboard users need clear focus target.

toma (Product): copy note: label collapsed chip 'View metrics' is vague. propose 'Chart controls' or 'Chart legend & alerts'. prefer explicit: 'Legend & alerts'.

sam (Design): agree 'Legend & alerts' then subtitle in expanded view: 'Sampling: 1% • p95 • Throughput • Events'. tooltip: 'Open controls to toggle overlays and view sampling info.'

ops-bot: perf reminder: toggling overlays should not force full re-render of tiles; debounce UI calls. Also record telemetry when users toggle sampling info.

ila (Eng UI): implementation: use a single <button> that opens a popover. inside, keyboard tab order first control is sampling toggle + info link, then overlay checkboxes. will prototype CSS + aria.

sam (Design): acceptance criteria: 1) collapsed chip shows sampling badge when sampling <5%, 2) chip has aria-label 'Open chart legend and alerts', 3) expanded panel lists toggles and a 'learn more' link to docs, 4) state persisted per-board.

toma (Product): let's ship behind feature flag to 5% and measure reduction in header complaints. thanks!
